question: How does the power-wheel expand from the central Bhairava reality?
premises: The Bhairava-self is to be worshiped at the center.
It is surrounded by twelve yoginīs.
From these the wheel of powers extends up to sixty-four.
inference: The central Bhairava reality unfolds outward as a wheel of powers, first as twelve yoginīs and then expanding to sixty-four.
uncertainties: The form tābhya is irregular in the supplied text and is read contextually as ablative plural.
plain_english: One should worship the Bhairava-self surrounded by twelve yoginīs; from them the wheel of powers extends up to sixty-four.
